format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-pager id="cards" prev-href="#install" prev-title="Подключение" next-href="#fields" next-title="Поля ввода"></sf-pager>
<sf-pager id="row" appearance="row" prev-href="#a" prev-title="Предыдущая запись блога" next-href="#b" next-title="Следующая запись блога"></sf-pager>

<sf-pager id="course" appearance="course" current="2"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "l1", "title": "Что такое смарт-компонент", "meta": "5 минут"}, {"id": "l2", "title": "Первая страница", "meta": "8 минут"}, {"id": "l3", "title": "Данные и порт", "meta": "6 минут"}, {"id": "l4", "title": "Свой вид", "meta": "7 минут"}, {"id": "l5", "title": "Публикация", "meta": "4 минуты"}]}</script></sf-pager>

<sf-pager id="counter" appearance="counter" current="2" keys><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "1040", "title": "Заявка № 1040"}, {"id": "1041", "title": "Заявка № 1041"}, {"id": "1042", "title": "Заявка № 1042"}, {"id": "1043", "title": "Заявка № 1043"}, {"id": "1044", "title": "Заявка № 1044"}, {"id": "1045", "title": "Заявка № 1045"}, {"id": "1046", "title": "Заявка № 1046"}, {"id": "1047", "title": "Заявка № 1047"}, {"id": "1048", "title": "Заявка № 1048"}, {"id": "1049", "title": "Заявка № 1049"}, {"id": "1050", "title": "Заявка № 1050"}, {"id": "1051", "title": "Заявка № 1051"}]}</script></sf-pager>

probes.title: cards draws two links with rel prev and next inside a nav named by label; a missing side keeps its place
probes.covers: settings.appearance cards, prev-href, prev-title, next-href, next-title, label, accessibility.role navigation

steps.check: (() => { const n = document.querySelector('#cards > nav'); const p = n.querySelector('a[rel="prev"]'); const x = n.querySelector('a[rel="next"]'); const h = document.querySelector('#half > nav'); const hx = h.querySelector('a[rel="next"]'); return n.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Соседние страницы' && p.getAttribute('href') === '#install' && p.textContent.includes('Назад') && p.textContent.includes('Подключение') && x.getAttribute('href') === '#fields' && x.textContent.includes('Далее') && !h.querySelector('[rel="prev"]') && Math.abs(hx.getBoundingClientRect().right - h.getBoundingClientRect().right) < 1 && hx.getBoundingClientRect().width < h.getBoundingClientRect().width * 0.6; })()

probes.title: a link asks sf-pager-navigate with its address; the browser follows it and no change is sent
probes.covers: events.navigate on a link, events.change not sent

probes.title: a page that cancels the request keeps the page: the link is not followed
Next moves a step: the request, then the fact; the place line and the track follow
probes.covers: settings.appearance steps, settings.items, values.current, events.navigate, events.change

probes.title: a page cancels the request while the step is not valid: the step stays and no change is sent
the last step's button says Готово; pressing it finishes the walk
probes.covers: settings.done-label, values.complete, host-states data-complete, events.navigate direction finish

probes.title: Back on the second step moves to the first and hands focus to Next as Back turns disabled

steps.check: document.querySelector('#steps .sf-pager-back button').disabled === true && document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#steps .sf-pager-forward button')

probes.title: course: dots done, current and ahead; Начать opens the next lesson
probes.covers: settings.appearance course, item meta, runtime words lesson, next-lesson, start

steps.check: document.querySelector('#course .sf-pager-place').textContent.trim() === 'Урок 3 из 5' && document.querySelectorAll('#course .sf-pager-dot--done').length === 2 && document.querySelectorAll('#course .sf-pager-dot--current').length === 1 && document.querySelector('#course .sf-pager-lesson .sf-pager-meta').textContent.trim() === 'Следующий урок · 7 минут' && document.querySelector('#course .sf-pager-lesson .sf-pager-title').textContent.trim() === 'Свой вид'

probes.title: the last lesson finishes the course; Сначала starts over
probes.covers: values.complete, runtime words finished, restart, events.navigate direction restart

probes.title: counter: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft on the page move the record (keys)
probes.covers: settings.appearance counter, settings.keys, keyboard ArrowLeft ArrowRight, runtime words position, prev-item, next-item

probes.title: the action next asks the request and moves without a change event (§8)
in an English container the words are English

steps.check: document.querySelector('#en .sf-pager-place').textContent.trim() === 'Step 1 of 3 · Источник' && document.querySelector('#en .sf-pager-forward .sf-button-text-container').textContent.trim() === 'Next' && document.querySelector('#en > nav').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Adjacent pages'
